# Claude Cage на русском (Russian localization of Claude Cage)

> Неофициальный русификатор Claude Cage v0.1.8: изолированная среда для Claude Code и Claude Desktop через свой прокси.
> Unofficial Russian localization of Claude Cage v0.1.8 — an isolated workbench for Claude Code and Claude Desktop via your own proxy.

## Links

- This repository: https://github.com/fatamakoff/Claude-Cage-ru (default branch: `ru`)
- Upstream project: https://github.com/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage

## Keywords

Claude Cage на русском, русификатор Claude Cage, Claude Code в России, русская локализация Claude Cage, Russian localization of Claude Cage, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Anthropic, proxy, VPN, sandbox, VM, isolated environment.

## What it is

Claude Cage is a desktop app that runs a terminal, browser, editor, and official Claude Desktop in an isolated guest (macOS, Windows, or Linux). All guest network traffic goes through a user-supplied proxy. This repository translates the UI and messages into Russian; program logic is unchanged from upstream v0.1.8.

## Install and build

1. Install official Claude Cage v0.1.8 from https://claude-cage.com/ru/#download
2. Clone this repo: `git clone -b ru https://github.com/fatamakoff/Claude-Cage-ru.git`
3. Build with Go and Node.js: `make cage` (Windows alternative: `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/build-windows.ps1`). Output: `_output/bin/cage.exe`
4. Back up and replace `resources\cage.exe` in the official install folder with the built binary.
5. To keep auto-update from overwriting the Russian build, create `%USERPROFILE%\.claude-cage\no-app-update` or set `CAGE_DISABLE_APP_UPDATE`.
